description: This file defines a toolbar text modifier for CKEditor, including functions for creating and managing toolbar configuration, hint containers, and code editing features within the toolbar configurator sample.

classes.name: ToolbarConfigurator.ToolbarTextModifier
classes.description: A modifier class for CKEditor toolbar text, extending AbstractToolbarModifier, managing code editor integration and toolbar hints.

methods.name: _onInit
methods.description: Initializes the modifier, calling parent _onInit and creating the modifier with configuration.

methods.name: _createModifier
methods.description: Creates the toolbar modifier, sets up CodeMirror editor, and manages hint container.

methods.name: _fillHintByUnusedElements
methods.description: Populates the hint container with unused toolbar items grouped by toolbar group.

methods.name: getToolbarGroupByButtonName
methods.description: Returns the toolbar group name for a given button name.

methods.name: getUnusedButtonsArray
methods.description: Returns an array of unused toolbar buttons, optionally sorted.

methods.name: groupButtonNamesByGroup
methods.description: Groups button names by their toolbar group.

methods.name: _mapToolbarGroupsToToolbar
methods.description: Maps toolbar groups to a toolbar configuration array.

methods.name: _mapToolbarSubgroup
methods.description: Maps a subgroup of toolbar buttons.

methods.name: _mapButtonsToButtonsNames
methods.description: Converts button objects to their names, filtering based on removed buttons.

methods.name: _evaluateValue
methods.description: Evaluates a string value into a toolbar configuration object.

methods.name: mapToolbarToToolbarGroups
methods.description: Maps a flat toolbar array into grouped toolbar configuration.
